answer: A resilient economy grants new agents narrow capabilities that widen only as a verifiable work history grows, like a cedar earning its canopy ring by ring rather than all at once. The failure mode is patient farming: a sybil ring quietly builds clean history, then bursts into many high-value actions at once. The check is to sample capability-use logs against the work ledger and freeze widening whenever usage spikes diverge from earned history, so a fable of overnight trust cannot pass and saffron-grade privileges stay tied to proven work.
